title: 1권 10유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: A sunny meadow corner of the second garden. A shaggy brown yak with long horns licks strawberry yogurt out of a big cup, and a glowing golden seed is stuck on the yak's pink yogurt-covered nose. Bun points at the yak laughing; Hedgie holds the yogurt cup; Pip plays with a red yo-yo, the string wrapped around its wing. Hidden in the picture: the yak, the yogurt cup, the yo-yo. Far away on the hill path, Grumble is walking away from the garden alone with a little bundle on a stick over his shoulder, looking back over his shoulder with a sad frown; his lantern in his other paw shines very bright, like a star. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
